name: Global Wheat Head Detection (GWHD) Dataset
description: The Global Wheat Head Detection (GWHD) dataset is a premier international benchmark created to advance high-throughput plant phenotyping and automated wheat yield estimation. Assembled through an extensive global consortium encompassing nine research institutions across seven countries (France, Switzerland, UK, Japan, Australia, Canada, and China), the dataset comprises 4,700 high-resolution RGB images containing over 190,000 labeled wheat head bounding boxes. Spanning diverse wheat cultivars, development stages, sowing densities, row orientations, and canopy architectures, GWHD provides an unmatched testbed for developing robust, generalizable object detection algorithms capable of handling severe visual occlusions and variable field illumination.
